status: Complete: all twenty independent role reports received; coordinator priorities and conditional deferrals locked
method: Impact, evidence strength, dependencies and effort. No invented reach, revenue or guaranteed score uplift. Original priorities remain in role reports; coordinator waves resolve conditional launch gates and deliberate deferrals.

packages.title: Preserve candidate work across sign-in, navigation and saving
packages.decision: Hydrate recovery only after account ownership settles; preserve exact final edits on same-input navigation; protect tracking drafts and keep optional account saving independent of local export.
acceptance_criteria: Delayed same-owner refresh restores the consented draft; another owner never sees it.
Back/forward and unchanged recheck preserve final edits; replacing source requires explicit action and undo.
Unsaved tracking notes/date survive task navigation with fresh attestation where required.
A stalled optional cloud save cannot indefinitely block an already approved local export; ambiguous save retry retains its request identity.
packages.implementation_status: partial: v22 and v26 controlled work-preservation repairs shipped; hosted/unassisted acceptance remains open
remaining_acceptance: Hosted native file receipt/opening and supported mobile verification
Fresh production signup/email/OAuth continuation and unassisted first/second application acceptance
Memory-only undo/tracking limitations remain explicit; no hard-refresh guarantee without separate consent/design
completed_within_validation_scope: Delayed auth/final-edit preservation remain covered by v22 correct regressions
Exact arbitrary source/file replacement undo with fresh approval
Dirty-field server refresh/recovery and fresh status attestation
Optional saving independent of approved local export; unchanged retry identity retained
Independent stale-operation tests and full1198-case suite passed; live created source/final undo observed

packages.title: Make erasure a durable, resumable operation
packages.decision: Fence every account mutation and storage write while erasing, persist bounded deletion progress, verify the prefix is empty, and safely collect abandoned artifacts. Add an owner procedure for loop-only and whole-account scope.
acceptance_criteria: The locally reproduced enroll-after-begin-erase race cannot admit a new run or upload.
More than10000 synthetic storage entries erase through bounded retries that each make progress.
Cancelled upload-before-commit artifacts expire safely without removing active referenced or other-owner files.
Completion is reported only after verified scope readback; actual/uncertain monthly commitments remain retained.
A synthetic whole-account checklist covers separate checks, CV stores, Auth, files and external copies without claiming control over already downloaded files.
packages.implementation_status: partial: v23/v24 erasure/lifetime repairs and v25 gated terminal collection shipped; actual collection disabled
completed_within_validation_scope: Original enrollment/storage interleaving now refused in local SQL; production definitions/privileges read back
10001 synthetic objects removed through 11 bounded calls with retry progress
Actual, uncertain and reserved shared commitments preserved in real PGlite fixtures
Generation-checked finish requires empty exact private prefix; refresh continuation tested locally
Generation-bound schedule, run, support, mailbox and erasure mutations reject old HTTP intents after fresh enrollment
Matching owner/generation required for route-draft recovery; confirmations reset across new lifetimes
Mutation-result snapshots do not activate a new record; anchored snapshots reject changed lifetimes
Native bound routine privileges and exact control v13/worker v10/OAuth v4 deployed bytes verified
Bounded terminal-run collector, all-status references and permanent closed-path tombstones implemented; disabled/empty allowlist read back on production
Independent purpose-ticket hourly wakeup installed; disabled dispatch returns null without issuing requests
Six real isolated PostgreSQL concurrency checks pass, including actual worker commit vs collection; cluster stopped
remaining_acceptance: Dedicated synthetic hosted Storage upload/remove/readback and hosted dispatch verification
Safe activation and observed collection outcome; real candidate collection stays disabled under current constraints
Whole-account synthetic checklist execution and coordinated restore rehearsal

packages.title: Carry the first check into one reusable application workspace
packages.decision: Offer an owner-bound preview to continue a completed check in Job Loop, importing the chosen CV version and vacancy once. Let candidates explicitly choose one or two vacancies for manual preparation.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen CV version and vacancy survive sign-in without retyping for all three audience paths.
Import requires private-storage consent; imported facts remain unconfirmed and unshareable until reviewed.
Retried import creates one linked application without destructive historical merging.
The third saved vacancy can be chosen first; two-packet and ownership limits remain server-enforced.
Test combining role and vacancy intake to remove one screen; retain user confirmation and the no-CV starter.

packages.title: Tailor emphasis per vacancy without changing shared career facts
packages.decision: Add a versioned selection/order of complete confirmed claims per opportunity, with requirement/source context next to the editing task. Generate interview prompts from constrained templates or verified template IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Shortening or reordering document B leaves source facts and document A unchanged.
A changed composition revokes B approval and is re-rendered before download.
Academic, team, projection and individual-contribution context cannot be silently omitted.
Invented titles, employers and achievements cannot enter interview questions through free-form model presuppositions.
A candidate can connect an edit to its vacancy requirement and source passage without repeated page hunting.

packages.title: Finish one coherent, readable review-and-download journey
packages.decision: Apply shared public/private design tokens and readable supporting text. Sequence final wording, required preview, factual approval and download; place optional save/reuse after the primary outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Private consent and help text are comfortably readable at supported mobile widths and zoom.
A first-time participant can identify the next primary action at every final-review state.
Changing text/format still invalidates the appropriate preview and approval.
Optional choices do not obscure approved download; no critical consent is preselected to reduce effort.

packages.title: Prove hosted signup, recovery and received document quality
packages.decision: Create a small repeatable deployment smoke and a rights-cleared fictional document corpus. Verify ordinary-address authentication and recovery using controlled fixture accounts; bound and cancel untrusted file extraction.
dependencies: Owner-controlled test inbox and existing SMTP/configuration evidence
acceptance_criteria: Record provider acceptance versus actual confirmation/reset receipt separately, including expired links and throttles.
Built deployment loads the real PDF worker, completes guest review, saves a file and verifies its opened content/layout.
Controlled sign-in/save/reopen preserves the selected owner and source version.
Independently reviewed multi-column, Unicode, long and scanned-document cases have correct reading order or an explicit usable fallback.
Extraction has cumulative limits, deadline and cancellation; no runaway work persists after cancellation.

packages.title: Harden sensitive administrator actions and public intake limits
packages.decision: Enforce recent strong administrator authentication for sensitive controls and verify intake identity only from trusted ingress. Keep fresh membership checks and server-only authority.
dependencies: Existing admin audit and account-change tests
acceptance_criteria: An otherwise valid low-assurance admin session cannot perform configured sensitive actions; recovery/enrollment is understandable.
Ordinary candidates cannot become administrators by signup, route access or client flags.
Spoofed forwarded-header fixtures cannot evade the intended rate identity.
No keys, private messages, CV text or receipt secrets are exposed through diagnostics.

packages.title: Join release evidence, rollback and data restoration
packages.decision: Make one current release/operations index authoritative; include every required migration in the manifest; retire or fix the auxiliary Pages deployment; rehearse code rollback and isolated synthetic private-data/file restoration.
acceptance_criteria: Guest-support migration is included with its digest; omission fixtures fail release validation.
A failed build never uploads/deploys fallback public assets; canonical production target is explicit.
A release receipt joins frontend source/version, edge artifacts/versions and schema migration hashes.
Synthetic restore recovers ownership isolation, matching packet bytes and spending commitments; actual restore time/data-loss window are recorded.
Every active documented command exists; obsolete guides clearly redirect and blanket browser storage clearing is removed.
One capability matrix consistently states two-query/two-packet limits, current audiences and configured/optional/proposed features.

packages.title: Show what actually ran, failed and needs attention
packages.decision: Add safe correlation references, immutable processing-route receipts, distinct usable/partial/blocked outcomes and worker acknowledgement/progress. Correct settlement only for verifiably unbilled rejection; keep genuine uncertainty reserved.
acceptance_criteria: A fictional candidate error links to an authorized worker event/run summary without private content in diagnostics.
Expected unavailable lane, provider fault, input hold and uncertain paid operation have distinct actions.
Worker500/timeout becomes actionable even while Cron dispatch attempts continue; paused/idle queues remain quiet.
Changing today's provider configuration cannot relabel yesterday's actual route; missing legacy metadata is explicitly unknown.
Only verified no-usage rejection releases its reservation; ambiguous calls remain held and never blindly replay.
Repeated identical faults group into one issue with count, owner, next action and recovery evidence.

packages.title: Give every candidate a useful support reply and findable help
packages.decision: Extend private Loop requests with versioned replies/dispositions, atomic idempotent intake and a shared founder view of guest/private queue age. Add task-language search aliases and account-access recovery help.
acceptance_criteria: A signed-in candidate reads a saved explanation and next step; another owner cannot access it.
Concurrent/retried intake creates one request under an atomic quota; stale reply writes are rejected and audited.
An older unresolved request remains findable as newer resolved cases arrive.
Resume upload, lost draft, password, evidence mismatch and cost hold lead to the appropriate task.
Support read/reply does not implicitly email anyone or send private text to a model.

packages.title: Define and measure a useful first and second application
packages.decision: Use one minimal event dictionary and consented ten-person research ledger. Separate guest/account flows, QA/cohort eligibility, actual candidate actions, scheduled preparation, opened usable artifacts and paired active effort.
acceptance_criteria: A metadata-only guest count can describe source→check→review→approved export action without CV text or sensitive URLs.
Prepared request, received inquiry, admitted account and genuine research participant remain separate denominators.
Scheduled runs cannot count as a voluntary human return; successful job-search exit is distinguished from harmful dropout.
First/repeat task records include active minutes, assistance, corrections, usefulness and non-completion reason.

Six usable first tasks/four voluntary repeats are only a provisional continue-learning trigger; broad expansion additionally requires eight usable completions, no systematic persona failure and cleared reliability gates.
Every report labels sample size, proxy semantics and missing evidence; ten participants do not establish population conversion or hiring success.
Server-owned cohort classification distinguishes participant, staff, demo, QA and unknown; costs and occupied seats retain all categories.
A usable packet from a partial run can reach its own approval/export task stage without claiming full source coverage.
Competitive exercises use identical fictional material or separately consented data and compare existing workflow plus two relevant alternatives; no superiority claim precedes observed results.

packages.title: Know all-in pilot cost and fair access before pricing
packages.decision: Maintain the hard shared ceiling, reconcile uncertain usage through a documented provider-evidence process, and show candidate/admin allocation, useful-artifact cost and separate infrastructure/operator expense. Keep future prices as experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Committed equals settled actual plus reserved/uncertain liabilities across candidate and admin paths.
One account or admin batch cannot silently consume the pilot's intended allocation; the shared hard ceiling remains authoritative.
Cost per useful artifact states allocation/denominator and includes retries/failures; no fictitious exact packet-level cost is inferred from multi-packet runs.
Hosting, database, email/media/tools and founder support time are listed separately from the US$50 model/search cap.
Focus$15/Loop$29 remain uncharged hypotheses until actual cost, value and payment eligibility are established.

packages.title: Use one clear offer and preserve audience context
packages.decision: Align invitations, landing pages, help and historical assets around one CV plus one actual vacancy. Distinguish available self-serve software, assisted research and the ten-seat private pilot. Use MBA students/alumni job recruiting consistently.
acceptance_criteria: A new reader can state inputs, deliverable, review responsibility and next action in their own words.
Student/MBA/professional links preserve intended audience into /check and link two relevant guides.
Explanatory saving links reach the public /job-loop overview; private work actions intentionally reach /loop.
Two role directions are not required to try the current first task; a second vacancy is a later optional reuse task.
Concept-demo/guided invitations and working-software invitations have explicit matching destinations.

packages.title: Prepare a qualified, capacity-aware first-ten pilot
packages.decision: Separate partner service relevance from participant readiness. Prepare a provisional3student/3MBA/4professional cohort, stage one participant per segment first, and verify actual cloud seats/support capacity before enrollment.
dependencies: Founder relationships and later authorized recruitment
Current active/QA enrollment and committed budget
acceptance_criteria: Each intended participant has an actual vacancy, existing CV/project evidence, available review time and a segment/source record.
Coach relevance, current service verification and willingness to introduce remain separate fields; unknowns stay unknown.
Request reception→acknowledgement→admission→agreed task is rehearsed with fictional data.
Ten participants are not promised ten additional cloud seats or an automaticUS$5entitlement.
A named owner/back-up checks both support queues and handles public exposed-data/inaccurate-claim concerns.
No invitations, followups, ads or messages are sent by this audit; founder research/support time is separately budgeted.

packages.title: Build one evidence-led content and launch kit
packages.decision: Upgrade four anchor guides around one reusable evidence worksheet with accurate per-guide dates. Prepare an original short fictional demo and persona variations, then test one distribution channel after pilot gates. Maintain a dated primary-source competitor watch.
dependencies: Verified product-screen capture and opened download
acceptance_criteria: Four guides cover CV-vacancy evidence, student projects, MBA pivots and second-application reuse using one concrete worksheet.
Guide updates change their own truthful dates/reviewer notes and relevant internal links.
A captioned35-second original demonstration uses enlarged readable passages, explicit fictional/AI labels and current /check CTA.
One master provides student, MBA and professional hooks without copying other creators or fabricated results.
LinkedIn and later Product Hunt/eligible Show HN are prepared as channel hypotheses; paidBetaList is excluded now.
A competitor update records observed URL/date/changed capability and whether it changes a product decision; no universal superiority or rank claims.

packages.title: Defer optional email automation until it is requested and justified
packages.decision: Keep drafts only now. Before future optional sending, implement purpose-specific choices, suppression/unsubscribe, idempotent task-based outbox and discreet actionable digests. Auth messages remain a separate operational stream.
dependencies: Existing sender/account decision and separate service costs
acceptance_criteria: Signup, pilot inquiry and preparation consent never silently subscribe anyone to optional mail.
Optout/complaint/bounce/erasure stop queued optional sends; unsubscribe works without login.
Completed/paused/closed tasks cancel reminders; timezone and duplicate-dispatch cases send at most one useful message.
No employer names, private CV text, receipt secrets or attachments are exposed in subject/tracking links.
Recommendation-only four-email draft sequence is tested with willing readers before any activation.

packages.title: Harden optional Gmail reconnect before enabling it
packages.decision: Keep optional Gmail off until its existing account/release gates are satisfied. Persist reconnect-required on revoked/expired credentials; distinguish transient failures and ambiguous draft creation.
acceptance_criteria: Revocation/expiry cannot continue to claim an inbox check or connected working credentials.
Transient429/5xx preserves the connection and shows last successful check separately.
Ambiguous draft creation never blindly creates a duplicate; no employer message is sent automatically.

packages.title: Tighten transaction ordering and measured query growth
packages.decision: Use a consistent record/run lock order, fetch summary projections/cursors and apply measured indexes on actual query paths. Select recoverable leases before limiting the queue.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent correction/commit stress tests preserve stale-input authority without lock-order deadlocks.
Run summaries exclude unused full snapshots and selected packets load on demand.
Live lease rows cannot starve recoverable older work through a pre-filter limit.
Index changes are justified by measured plans; advisor counts alone are not a reason to add or remove indexes.

packages.title: Keep paid subscriptions behind a separate commercial release
packages.decision: Keep checkout disabled. Later replace the old one-time ten-pack contract with one agreed recurring entitlement specification only when paid scope and account eligibility are established.
dependencies: Eligible merchant/provider account and paid-scope decision
acceptance_criteria: Focus/Loop proposed prices and pack/run allowances match server-side recurring entitlements.
Renewal/reset, cancellation, failed payment, refund, duplicate event and reconciliation fixtures pass before real charges.
No legacy ten-pack route or fabricated paid entitlement silently substitutes for the subscription offer.
No payment account, gateway, recurring charge or paid conversion is activated by this audit.
